translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Peepundu pañu palaa
Iya Pablo, Jesucristochi taawasha kemu ruku, entsa kiika ñullanu piikentsuyu. Iya Jesús' mitya kuinda kenu lara' eranu mikayayu, ura patiñuya, Diosa' mika ura kuinda mijakares nenu te'laraa chachiyu,
matyu Dios kaspeleren ya' mitya pamu rukulanu piikikare' waingaatu, juntsa mika ura kuinda uwain mijakarenbera kenu dejuve timuwaañu' mitya.
Entsa kuinda pamiya Diosa' Na, Jesucristo, lala' Bale Ruku, chachi tiya' rei Davidnu sera' jamunaa laapu' pantsuve,
tsaaren Dioschin juu tirekaamu Espíritu Santo tsanguekaañaa, ya juntsai peya' mangujtu Diosa' Na ju' tsamantsaa ju' bain juntsai keengayave.

Jesucristo' mityaren iya, ya' mitya kuinda kenu lara' eramu ruku tiya', yachi taawasha kemu tireñu mika balengurentsuyu, tsejtaa nuka chumu chachillanuba yanu dekeenguikare', ya tyee kide tiñuba tsangue meenguen chumu chachi detirenu.
Ñui bain Jesucristochi tiyanu mikayamu chachi deeve.

Kumuinchi ñulla Dioschi estyanu chachilla, Roma pebulunu chudenashu juntsala, Dioschin juu chachi tiyanu mikayamula, lala' Apa Dios bain, Bale Ruku Jesucristo bain ñullanu estya' keeware' nejuu tiba bulla jutyu ura' dechujti' jintsusa tenñu piikentsuyu.
Pablo Romasha jinu tyami.
Kayu pa' ji'mujchiren tsandinu tenve: Jesucristo' mityaren, Diosnu ñulla' mitya yuj sundenve ti' pantsuyu, ñulla naake keengue' jindetsuñu bain nukaba tsai meejantsuñu' mitya.
In pensa pudengama yachi tiba kiike' ya' Na' mika ura kuinda wandis neintsaashu juntsa Diosya mive naa-uwanuba iya yaba kuinda kenu uranu ñullanu tengayaa tsanañu bain.
Tsenmin naa-uwanu Diosba kuinda kike' bain, yachi tsanguiñu uraaba jushu juntsaya, umaa ñulla' junga uu januu tinbu janmalaya inu eeka ti' papatinchin juuyu.
Tsangue' ñullanu kayu daran keenguenu mijakaamishtinmala, ñulla kayu dera' keengues dejisa tenñu' mityaa, ñullanu katanu pensayu,
tsaaren ura pañuya, naa iya bain, naa ñui bain manbarejuren keengues jiindetsaashu juntsatala veta' veta' kuinda deke' sundyanu ju' mityaa ñullanu katanu pensayu.

Keranguemu naatalala, iya ñulla' junga janu ketindun, chaikama jakeenu kindyuñuba ñulla demijasa tenve. In pensaya ñulla' chundala bain Diosnu dekeenguikare' kayu awa' jintsunu detikare' vee mujtu bain naakemu ju'ba, juntsangue' puka iwaren tsanguenu pensayu,

matyu in pensaya naa munu bain tsaren Diosa' palaa mijakaranu juve tenve, naa griego palaachi pamulanu bain, naa vejan chachillanu bain, naa aseetaju chachillanu bain, naa aseeta jutyu chachillanu bain.
Tsa' mitya ñulla' chunu Romasha bain ja' Diosa' mika ura kuinda kes nenu ajchundenve.
Diosa' mika ura kuindaya dera.

Inuya Diosa' mika ura kuinda kes nenu jaiba yujtendyuve, juntsa mika ura kuinda' mityaa Dios pude ju'ba juntsa keeware' mun keranguiñuba livee inu tiremu juñu' mitya. Livee inu kuinda ajke' mijakaamiya judío chachillanaa mijakaanu tsuyu, naa bene judío chachi jutyulanu bain tsaren mijakaanu ju'ba.

Entsa Diosa' mika ura kuinda, naaketaa Dios lalanu tichiba kuipajtu tiremuñuba tsangue keewaamuve, vera jutyu, kerangue' uwain tsaave tyaturen juu. Tsandive Diosa' Kiikanu: Dios naakesa tyañuba tsanguen chumu chachiya Diosnu ura' keenguen mityaa chunu tsuve,
ti' pillave.
Mu bain Diosa' ajuushakuipa deeve.

Naa Diosnu bain, naa ne chachillanu bain tsangue' firu' kiikemu chachillanu, Dios selusharen naake taaju iwaanu ju' bain tsaa dekeewaantsuve, matyu entsaa chachilla mika firu' kenchin veelanu Dios naa naajuñuba juntsaa aseetanguikaakaanu dejutyuñu' mitya.
Matyu Diosnu naa-i keemijanuu juñuba yala nara kera deeve, Diosren yalanu tsangue keewaañu' mitya.

Tsaaren naa yanu entsangue katanu dejutyu' bain, entsa tu dekenu tinbunuren tiba deke' jintsuñuba juntsanu keekituren mijanu dejuve, ya Dios ju', naa-uwanuba pude juñu bain. Tsaañu' mitya firu' ken chumu chachilla naati' ne mijtuwa deeyu tinu dejutyuve.

Naamika yala Diosnu kerawa deju'ba, naake balengure' keewaanuu juñuba tsanguindetyuñuve, tsenmin Dios ti bain uraa keñuba yala juntsan mitya mika ura' kive tindetyuñuve. Tsaju' tiba balejtutalaa aa pensanguen dechu', Dioschi tiba jumulanu tsaa katatyuñuu detiya' nejuu tiredekiñuve.
Naa yalaa aseetaju chachi deeyu tyamu deju' bain, tiba aseetanguityu chachi ne tiyaila,

matyu peyai'mujchi naa-uwanuba chumu Diosnu, rei juuñuu tsamantsaa jumunaa aawa kure' keewaatyumujchi, naa-uwanuba tsanatyu ne peyaimu chachilla' muute juulanu bain, naa pishku muute juulanu bain, naa taapai neepachi neimu animaa muute juulanu bain, naa ajkachi shilla' neimu animaa muute juulanu bain, juntsaaya ke' aawa kure' keewaawaakila.
Tsenñu' mitya Diosya yala naake firu' pensa deke'ba tsa dekisa tyatu yalanu tyallakiñu, yai tene veta' veta' yala' bulunu uu yujtyanuu tene kidekive.
Tsejtu yala uwain Diosnaa kerangui'mujchi, anbukuindanaa urave tya' demeengue', Dioschi tiba deke' faawara jumulanaa aawa kure' keewaala. ¡Tsaaren Diosya naa-uwanuba balenguramu jusa! Tsaasa.
Tsenñu' mityaa, yala naa kindya'ba tsa dekisa tya', Dios yalanu tyallakiñu, yala' supula unbee rukulaban tsainuu juunun supuutalan tsangue' mayujpeyaa kiidekive,

tsenmala unbee rukula bain supulaban tsainuu junun tsanguityu', yaatalaa veta' veta' tsainu tya' mayujpeyaa kiidekive. Tsa' mitya yala' ujcha' mityan, ura yala' cha' bulunaa tsa tsai taaju pullandetsuve.
Tsenñu' mitya Diosya, yanu dekeenguityu' tituba pensandandaa judeeñu' mitya, yalanu tyallakive, tsenmalaa tyee urajtu kenu tya'ba tsangue dekisa tyatu.

Matyu juntsalaa entsaa tene kemu deeve: Dios naakesa tyañuba juntsaa kityu deju', firu' kemu deju, tanaturen kayu tiba tadinu tyamu deju, tituba urajtu kemu deju, kishtyamu deju, cha' tu'mu deju, vinbas nemu deju, anbuti' keranguekaamu deju, firu' ikaachi tyamu deju, na'baasa kuinda mere' mawandis nemu deju,

veelanu tituba pas nemu deju, Diosnu kundaa chachi deju, veelanu tituba kindyamee tsanguemu deju, dajtyamu deju, tichiba pulla deeyu tyamu deju, firu' kenu pensa kalare' tsanguenu tyamiya tsanguemishtimu deju, yala' apalanu meenguityu deju,
tyee urañu bain, tyee urajtuñu bain pensangue' kityu deju, naati pa'ba tsanguityu deju, estyatyu chachi deju, tsenmin tenbityatyu chachi deeve.

Tsaaren yala nara mideeve, naa juntsaa firu' ken chumu chachillaya peyainuu dejuve ti', Diosa' lei kiikanu tsa pillañuba, tsejturen yai bain juntsaaren ken chutyu deju', veela bain tsaren dekinmalaya, ura' dekive tya' sundyamu deeve.
